s1_global_budget_and_early_completion.evidence_aware_harvest: early harvest now requires settled>=60% AND totalRefs>=15 AND relevantRefs>=SC_EARLY_HARVEST_MIN_RELEVANT (default 5, 0=legacy count-only); few lexical hits or word-overlap refs no longer auto-complete the task
s1_global_budget_and_early_completion.red_found_and_fixed: REAL scheduling regression found by the red test: when enough became true via settle events, nextEdge jumped to the soft deadline so early harvest NEVER fired (all legs were awaited); fixed by always scheduling the min(harvestMs, softMs) edge with enough re-evaluated at the edge, restoring TS 25ms-polling semantics
s1_global_budget_and_early_completion.insufficiency_diagnosis: meta.harvest carries {early, settledLegs/totalLegs, abortedPending, relevantRefs/minRelevant, totalRefs, softDeadlineMs}; deadline expiry with insufficient evidence sets meta.harvest.insufficient=true plus a diagnosis string — obtained candidates are still returned, no indefinite rescue
tests: TestEarlyHarvestRequiresRelevantEvidence (red: 15+ irrelevant refs + 60% settled must NOT early-return)

s2_engine_health_rate_limit_recovery.retry_after: 429 responses now carry '(retry-after: Ns)' from the engine lanes (searxng loop, keenable, bingrss via retryAfterSuffix; HTTP-date form honestly ignored); the breaker cooldown takes max(policy, retry-after) bounded by the 1h cap — no retry storms against a server-declared backoff
s2_engine_health_rate_limit_recovery.negative_cache_safety: degraded or empty outputs are no longer written to the search cache (cache_skip_negative journal event); a temporary failure can never surface as a long-term no-results answer; cache hits re-run the evidence gate so policy drift cannot bypass it (cache_bypass_evidence journal event)
tests: TestBreakerCooldownRespectsRetryAfter (29s window open / 59min open / 61min closed for a 99999s retry-after)

s3_semantic_quality_sources_versions.evidence_gate_v2: lexical-evidence-v2 ported from TS v1 and strengthened: NFKC + operator/URL stripping + generic-term filter + light plural folding (recipes->recipe) + 50% evidence floor (TS v1 stays at 40%); S0-F2 reproduced red: query 'python list comprehension recipes cooking' accepted pure cooking pages at 40% (2/5 terms) — v2 rejects them while keeping python pages (3/5); TS side recorded as follow-up
s3_semantic_quality_sources_versions.version_applicability: meta.quality.versionCheck flags refs whose title/URL major version differs from an explicit query version (annotation only, never dropped) — old-version/experimental-branch answers are visible as such
s3_semantic_quality_sources_versions.source_mix: meta.quality.sourceMix counts official/community/unknown from the authority layer for transparent diagnosis
s3_semantic_quality_sources_versions.domain_cap: SC_DOMAIN_CAP env override for source diversity (0=off); topic-derived defaults preserved

s4_focused_fetch_reliability.shell_rejection: classifyPageShell (login_wall / js_shell / consent_wall; conservative: <600 runes extracted text + strong phrase markers) plus raw-body js-shell detection before extraction; shell pages return Blocked + a transparent refusal note — never a fabricated body; shell pages are cached to avoid repeat outbound hits, and cached shells are re-classified and rejected on every read
s4_focused_fetch_reliability.status_rejection: fetchExtract now rejects non-2xx statuses with a transparent 'http N' error (previously a 403 with an HTML body could be extracted as if it were an article); the DOI/OA fallback chain triggers on the explicit status error, covering all 403s instead of only empty extractions
s4_focused_fetch_reliability.fetch_transparency: FetchResult records via (direct/crates-api/oa-landing), original URL, final URL and fromCache; journal fetch_done includes url/finalUrl/via/textLength/fromCache — cache reuse is never reported as current network success

cli_contract_fix: cmdSearch previously ignored --engines entirely (EnginesSet never set — a real defect found while live-testing); now the user list constrains all routes and an explicit empty list is the zero-request contract, matching the MCP path
